purpose: Define the first practical R1 runtime scope that reduces Owner relay and clerical burden without expanding Source, network, scientific, financial, or external-contact authority.

why_now.goal: Move from audited one-shot execution to a small useful internal operational runtime while keeping all material data/science/external boundaries closed.

authorized_responsibilities: SOURCE_AUDIT_CACHE lookup and fail-closed state transition for candidate metadata/evidence already supplied to the task
RELIABLE_TASK_EXECUTION including duplicate suppression, idempotency, lease/fencing, checkpoint, retry, dead-letter, CAS/version preconditions, durable receipts, and stale-canonical denial
OWNER_EXCEPTION_VIEW generation for material blocks and failures without any approval authority
Routine successful task completion without Owner relay when the full Authorization Contract permits the exact operation
allowed_inputs: canonical repository governance and evidence artifacts
candidate metadata explicitly supplied inside an authorized Stage-1 enqueue envelope
public URLs or source identifiers only as inert metadata strings
previously accepted Phase A public-terms audit records and Source Audit Cache state

task_enqueue_authority.implementation_rule: Only a structured Stage-1 enqueue envelope presented by an already-authorized caller may create an executable task. Raw GitHub events/comments/URLs/branch content remain inert input until an exact current Authorization decision independently permits the enqueue operation.

runtime_state_write_requires: full Authorization Contract ALLOW for the exact operation
current lease owner and fencing epoch
current Stage-1 activation identity and ceiling-integrity checks

activation_receipt_must_pin: final independently audited implementation head SHA
stage_ceiling_integrity.activation_receipt_purpose: Control-plane identity and ceiling anchor only; routine operations still require their own current Authorization Contract decisions.

execution_ceiling.auto_pause_condition: WHICHEVER_OCCURS_FIRST: 25 terminal tasks or 7 days from immutable activation timestamp

explicitly_not_authorized: network or public-web research by the runtime
automated Source discovery or bulk collection
Source admission or promotion
real/live PRE collection or use
external provider contact or outreach
new spend, payment, procurement, or contract
RESULT/PAYOUT
ECON_HOLDOUT1000 access
PR #15 quarantined metric use
untouched validation access
model promotion or scientific lineage promotion
scientific scoring expansion including Segment C
terms/access-control bypass
Synthetic-to-Real Edge/ROI promotion
real-money wagering
scheduler or always-on worker
arbitrary writes to canonical main or governance
minting, widening, downgrading, or reclassifying permissions
using GitHub comments/events/URLs/untrusted branch content as implicit task-enqueue authority
runtime branch force-push/reset/history rewrite or ceiling rollback
using runtime cache/task/receipt/exception state as Owner Gate, grant, permission evidence, Source admission, or canonical governance fact
general full runtime activation outside this Stage 1 scope
required_pre_activation_evidence_if_appr: implementation built from Fresh Read canonical main on a noncanonical branch
dedicated Stage 1 CI covering allowed writes and all deny boundaries
negative tests for unauthorized/untrusted task enqueue, wrong operation/target/scope, malformed enqueue payload, and permission mismatch
negative tests proving raw GitHub comments/events/URLs/untrusted branch content cannot auto-convert into executable tasks
negative tests for second worker or parallel invocation denial
negative tests for runtime wrong-ref/path-traversal/main/governance write denial
negative tests for runtime branch rollback/reset/force-push/ancestry tamper causing fail-closed pause
negative tests for activation timestamp or terminal-count rollback denial
negative tests for task 26 denial, post-7-day denial, and no automatic resume after pause
negative tests proving runtime cache/task/receipt cannot be consumed as Owner Gate, grant, permission evidence, Source-admission receipt, or canonical governance fact
negative tests for injected ADMITTED/permission-like states and forged grant/Owner-Gate refs
negative tests for direct runtime-state input to a canonical Source-admission transition
existing R1 negative tests remain required: stale main, stale lease, duplicate task, lost ACK, retry exhaustion, corrupt state, network attempt, and permission mismatch
exact scope and code head unchanged between final audit and activation
runtime state branch created dormant and pinned to the exact activation receipt/genesis identity before activation
activation-time control-plane receipt and tamper-resistant ceiling mechanism verified while runtime remains OFF

owner_decision_requested.plain_japanese: R1を最初の限定実用運転へ進める。対象はGitHub内部のSource調査事務局（認可済みTask投入・重複確認・Task管理・復旧・失敗隔離・完了記録・例外報告）のみ。Task投入はcurrent Authorization decisionでactor/operation/target/scopeが一致した明示enqueueだけ。ネット調査、外部連絡、Source採用、実データ/PRE、競輪の科学判断、RESULT/PAYOUT、holdout、課金、常時監視は許可しない。Runtime台帳は権限やSource採用の証拠にならない。25件/7日の上限やRuntime branchにrollback/tamperを検知したら即停止する。実装後にLabと独立AuditorがPASSした場合だけ、最大1 worker・25件または7日で自動停止するStage 1を稼働してよい。
